verdict.rationale: Documented renewal pricing and cancellation or transfer-out terms are a fair question for a registered-agent service, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of renewal charges, cancellation, or transfer-out terms: the site's robots.txt returned a Cloudflare challenge, so nothing was fetched. The only community item is an off-topic comment about the company's search visibility. Confidence is low because the absence comes from blocked access, not from content that was reviewed.
